entries.text: Trino, Presto and Athena build their `CREATE TABLE` DDL with `translate_ddl` instead of adapter-side text rewrites. Table names are written quoted (`"orders"` on Trino and Presto, `` `orders` `` on Athena) instead of bare, and Athena columns are backtick-quoted; the statements are otherwise equivalent. `ddl_helpers.strip_with_properties` is removed. `translate_ddl` records one schema-DDL translation outcome per call, so schema statements still appear in the result's SQL translation summary.
